definitions.explanation: The area or direction in front of something or someone. A somewhat formal word for the space ahead.

examples.japanese: {前方|ぜんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{前方|ぜんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧きた。
examples.english: A large bridge came into view ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前方|ぜんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}して→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦ブレーキ→ブレーキ：00022_bureeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: A child jumped out in front of the car, so I slammed on the brakes.

notes:
{前方|ぜんぽう} is a formal word for 'ahead' or 'in front.' More formal than ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧, and commonly used in driving, announcements, and written instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前方|ぜんぽう}⟦{不注意|ふちゅうい}→不注意：15111_fuchuui⟧: failure to watch ahead (common traffic violation)
- {前方|ぜんぽう}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: forward check (driving safety)
- {前方|ぜんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: watch ahead
- {前方|ぜんぽう}⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧: front and back

DIRECTION SET:
- {前方|ぜんぽう}: front, ahead
- ⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧: rear, behind
- {左方|さほう}: left side
- {右方|うほう}: right side

CONTRAST WITH {前|まえ}:
⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ is everyday and casual. {前方|ぜんぽう} is formal and often technical — used in traffic reports, announcements, and official instructions.
